title: _alternative splits a spec at a backslash-escaped colon on zsh but not on zshrs

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0004

_fzc0004_helper0() { compadd -- alpha beta gamma }

_alternative \
  'one:a\:b colon:_alternative '\''eta:paren(s) here two  spaces:(two six eps gamma)'\'' '\''three:a\:b colon:_files'\'''

observed.notes: The spec is 'one:a\:b colon:_alternative ...'. zsh takes the text after the escaped colon as the ACTION and tries to run `b`, printing 'command not found: b'; zshrs prints nothing. The divergence is the diagnostic, i.e. where each shell splits the spec.

variants.note: second witness, confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 1 row differs, same one-sided '_alternative:71: command not found: b'). Different generated spec set, same shape.

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0007

_fzc0007_helper0() { compadd -- alpha beta gamma }

_alternative \
  'six:100% done:_files' \
  'delta:paren(s) here:_files' \
  'two:amp&and: _fzc0007_helper0' \
  'beta:a\:b colon:_alternative '\''one:amp&and at@sign:(zeta eps five)'\'' '\''theta:plain:_files'\'''

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was '1 row(s) differ'; this harness computes no fingerprint, so what was re-verified is the verdict and that detail line, not row-for-row identity with `observed`

history.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
